[SWS_CM_80022] Transport protocol for sending of an event message
Upstream requirements:

00010, RS_CM_00004
⌈
The event message shall be transmitted using
UDP
if the threshold defined by the
multicastThreshold
attribute of the
SomeipProvidedEventGroup
that is ag-
gregated by the
ProvidedSomeipServiceInstance
in the role
eventGroup
in the
Manifest has been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00134]).

the attribute
SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment
.
eventDeployment
.

portProtocol
in the Manifest if this threshold has not been reached (see [PRS_
SOMEIPSD_00802]).
